[ITST.10.2] **What a line and branch figure measures.** A C source must be
measured for lines and for branches, and a source in another language for
lines. A header the product includes and does not own must not be counted.
libds must report two figures, each over one instrumented build of the
commit under test:

| Figure | The tests it runs |
|---|---|
| unit | libds's own suites, `impl/` and `spec/` |
| all tests | those suites, the conformance corpus through pyds, libds's side of the runtime differential, and the binding suites |

Every other product's figure must be measured over its own suite. The wasm
build of libds compiles the same C source as native libds: native libds's
figures stand for it, and the report must say so.
